_comment: What the CFEngine policy files on the hosts define, keyed by the file's SHA-256 checksum (see files.json): bundles, bodies and promise types with their line numbers, and the variables, classes and calls (of functions, bundles and bodies) inside them with the block they are in. Generated by scripts/index_policy.mjs from hosts.json and files.json with the tree-sitter grammar for CFEngine; the frontend reads this file at build time.
